skill_context_used.applied_contract: Source/authority first; formulas, normalization, time variables, IC/BC, closure and exact function/data correspondence; distinguish measured counters from static work and future speed tests.

identity.typed_checks: BYTE identity for locked source/input/receipt hashes; STRUCTURAL mapping and counter-derived static work; no new NUMERICAL or SCIENTIFIC_EQUIVALENCE claim

formulas.time: x = ln(a/a_ref); y = s/H_star; h = H/H_star; no physical dimensional unit conversion performed by this adapter
formulas.cohort: d=b-b_birth, a=exp(2d)*(1-mu^2), c=exp(-4d)*mu^2, R=sqrt(a+c), N=c-a/2, D=N/R, D_b=(-4c-a)/R+2N^2/R^3; [E,Pi,Pi_b]=energy_birth*exp(-4*(x-u))*sum(alpha*[R,D,D_b])
formulas.donor: E_d=donor0*exp(-3*x-lambda*exposure); exposure frozen in each segment
formulas.event: u_j=(j+1/2)*birth_end/k; w=E_d_before*(-expm1(-lambda*du)); fixed state, append positive P24-certified new cohort, exposure=(j+1)*du, new bank/driver
formulas.objective: new-birth KL projection alpha_i proportional q_i*exp(lambda2*P2(mu_i)+lambda4*P4(mu_i)); sum alpha=1, sum alpha P2=sum alpha P4=0 to unchanged gates

static_cost_model.N: sum of stored angular nodes over current cohorts
static_cost_model.eval: O(N+C); 3*C+1 exp expressions; N sqrt expressions; C+1 explicit Vec constructions, requested numeric payload 24*(N+C) bytes; not simultaneous live bytes or measured allocator calls
static_cost_model.eval_transient_live_payload_upper_shape: 24*(C+max cohort node count), excluding allocator capacity rounding/metadata, stack and output structs
static_cost_model.callbacks: All RHS, analytic Ft, JVP and Small Jacobian callbacks call the same full eval once; JVP then performs a 3x3 matrix-vector operation.
static_cost_model.admin: initial observe + each successful segment scheduled output after initial + before/after birth eval + right-bank observation replacement; total observations+3*births
static_cost_model.projection: E evaluated distributions => 2*E explicit Vec constructions and n*E exp expressions; fixed overhead geometry/q/p2/p4/logq separate; not Newton iteration count
static_cost_model.compiler_caveat: Compiler may hoist expressions/elide allocations; only allocation/instruction instrumentation can establish actual runtime events.
